panel_description_zh: ⭐ 横向中景，平视对称构图（从两人背后略俯视 5 度）。画面左侧妻子背影（披散头发）+ 画面右侧李斌背影（短黑发），两人并排坐在沙发上各自面朝电视；电视冷白背光在两人前方打光；沙发靠背在两人身后形成剪影边缘；整个画面完全对称。

dialogue_or_narration.speaker: 妻子
dialogue_or_narration.tail_pointing: 画面外（妻子的嘴部方向）
dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 你说，你是不是对我朋友有意思，你有想法就说出来，我不怪你。

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions, muted warm-cool palette. Eye-level slightly high-angle 5-degree shot from behind a couple sitting side by side on the grey fabric sofa, a perfectly symmetric composition. LEFT: the wife's back, long straight black hair completely down flowing over her shoulders, fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top. RIGHT: the husband's back, short black slightly messy side-swept hair, loose grey cotton crew-neck t-shirt. Both figures sit facing forward toward an off-frame television, neither looking at the other, the shoulder line of each at the same height. The cool blue-white TV backlight is the only illumination on their fronts, casting the sofa backrest and their silhouettes into shadow behind. A faint reflection of the TV content on the back of the husband's head. The atmosphere is the coldest frame of the book, two people sharing a sofa but living in different rooms. Mood: the silent marriage, the cold violence of co-existence. Text watermark 'P13-PN06' in the bottom-right corner placed where it does not obscure the central symmetry line.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, smiling, faces visible (this is a back view only), decorative hallway art, daylight from a window, second character, romantic soft lighting, dramatic shadows, bright colors, faces turning toward each other (they must not look at each other)
